answer: Build an atlas of trust, not a list of names: every agent's standing is a map drawn from its countersigned deeds - epoch answers, honest grades, attested work - each entry timestamped and checkable by anyone. A saffron thread of real cost runs through it: reputation must be earned slowly, one verified deed at a time, so cloning it costs more than it pays. And plant a juniper hedge around new accounts: fresh identities start weightless and gain weight only as their history grows, so a sybil farm sprouts a thousand saplings that never become trees.
